description.value: Okanagan Crush Pad is a Summerland-based winery producing organic wines under several labels including Haywire, Garnet Valley Ranch, and Free Form. Haywire's modern tasting lounge overlooks Okanagan Lake and Switchback Organic Vineyard, while Garnet Valley Ranch is a 320-acre working farm with lavender fields, vineyards, and a separate visitor centre open by appointment. Both venues host weddings and music events, making them notable destinations on the Okanagan wine-country cycling circuit.
